newsitem.title: DUBAI: Saudi-German investment protection deal signed.
newsitem.headline: Saudi-German investment protection deal signed.

text.p: Saudi Arabia and Germany signed an investment protection agreement on Tuesday to foster economic relations between the two countries, the German embassy in the Saudi capital Riyadh said.
"The agreement can be seen as a breakthrough achievement and a model for similar agreements to be concluded between Saudi Arabia and other countries," the embassy said in a statement.
Germany is Saudi Arabia's fourth largest trading partner, while the Kingdom is Germany's top trading partner in the Arab world.

"Today's signing of the Saudi-German agreement on mutual encouragement and protection of investment is a very special occasion in the framework of our bilateral relations," German Ambassador Rudolf Rapke said in the statement.
Rapke signed the deal with Saudi Minister for Finance and National Economy Ibrahim Abdel Aziz al-Asaf in Riyadh, the embassy said.
The statement did not give further details on the agreement.
